Top-notch restaurant in Ha Noi
Oct 2026 • Friends
Excellent food, beverages, and service from Mizumi and Chi. We have several dietary requirements, and the team supported us in every way, making the whole experience very comfortable.

We came back especially for the chawanmushi and sashimi—the quality was truly top-notch.

One small point for improvement: the TripAdvisor QR code needs to be fixed, as it currently leads directly to a website that is quite confusing and makes it difficult to leave a review.

Excellent
Sep 2026 • Solo
I came to Mizumi for dinner two nights in a row and had a fantastic experience both times. On my second visit I ordered a wide range of dishes, and everything was delicious.
The quality of the sashimi and sushi was excellent. The ingredients were clearly very high quality and everything was beautifully prepared.
I was served by Quan on both evenings, and he was extremely attentive, friendly and professional. He made both visits feel very welcoming.
Highly recommend Mizumi if you’re looking for excellent Japanese food in Hanoi.

Wonderful dinner, highly recommended
Sep 2026 • Solo
I learned about Mizumi through a review on TikTok, and now I finally have the chance to have dinner at the restaurant. The restaurant dinner has two set options, I chose the set with fish, premium ingredients, suitable for a rich, traditional Japanese taste. Alcohol-free drinks are quite diverse, easy to drink, and have fruit flavors. The service is sophisticated, the staff is thoughtful and takes care, the staff member Chi is enthusiastic, the photos are very beautiful <3
